crossRefs.note: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
“Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,

translations.web: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
translations.bsb: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
translations.kjv: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
translations.asv: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild asses quench their thirst.
